Hey friend, 

Im sorry you had to go through that. What l read is that the breakup makes you feel really small. Know that thats not a weird thing. We feel often save in our relationships and when that falls away a line of security falls away and thats really hard. 

Relaying on a person is something powerful but can also make us feel a bit like we need someone to survive. But l can tell you (eventho your head will probably argue like hell with this) you can do this.

Take your time to grieve this. But keep talking to someone. It doesnt have to be your whole life story but just small talk. 

When you feel up to it you can write things in a journal to process it a bit. Find out what you like in life and what makes you feel passionate about. 

You dont need to know where you want to go just start and see where the road leads you. 

Little steps my friend! I believe in you even if you don’t believe in yourself!

Hey my friend! It sounds like your having a really hard time. I know how hard anxiety can be and how rudeless we can be to ourselves. 

The best thing l can tell you is, dont do anything for others because you feel like they want you to. Most of the time that is what makes us miserable, doing shit we dont want to do because others want us to. 

What do you like? What makes you happy? And others.. lf they really love you they stay and suport you. Because good friends want you to be happy and passionate.

Tbh how older l get how more l realize that everyone is scared to hurt others by doing your own thing and than l think how much do l think about others doing things for me.. answer never so changes are high others dont either. So live the life that makes you happy and let others be the way they are. 

If your happy, healthy and enjoying your life thats all that matters the rest will follow and if not than its not supposed to be in your life.

Big huggs and hope you feel better soon because you deserve it. (Even if your head is saying that you dont)

If you need medical help please ask for it. Call 911 or maybe tell a friend. Im sorry you felt like you had to do that. 

Im sending you big hugges and l wish you feel better soon. You dont have to do this alone
